explication: Meteor is a Fabric utility mod for Minecraft anarchy servers. Its runtime brings up the client, discovers addons, loads systems and configuration, and exposes in-game controls such as commands and GUI tabs for operating modules. Modules respond to game events and can affect gameplay or rendering; the repository also includes HUD, waypoint, account, proxy, and pathing capabilities. The README establishes the product purpose; relationships below are limited to shown source references and excerpts, so the graph is not a complete runtime trace.
